elements.title: Inside the quiet room of the Acoustics Lab
elements.content: A group of five people stands inside an acoustics quiet room lined with sound-absorbing panels. Printed caption: “Inside the quiet room of the Acoustics Lab, Zach Jones of NASA’s Human Health and Performance Directorate speaks with Northrop Grumman’s Grant Cooper and Jay Boucher, Leah Honey, and Cooper Burleson of NASA’s Commercial Low Earth Orbit Development Program. The quiet room provides a low acoustic noise environment used for audio recording and subjective audio performance testing.” Photo credit: “James Blair, April 2, 2024”
